components.name: proposition
values: perturb-seq combines pooled crispr screens with single-cell rna-seq to dissect transcriptional effects of genetic perturbations at scale.

components.name: proposition
values: perturb-seq can scale to larger screens genome-wide or combinatorial screens are feasible with increasing cell throughput and computational bandwidth and future improvements e.g. cpf1 lineage tracing are compatible.

components.name: proposition
values: in k562 cells perturb-seq reveals tf modules and cell-cycle regulator effects consistent with known biology and cell-state covariates improve reproducibility of tf-specific effects.

components.name: proposition
values: tf binding patterns chip-seq support the model s predictions activating tfs targets are downregulated upon perturbation and repressors targets are upregulated genetic interactions are associated with co-binding.

components.name: proposition
values: in bmdcs transcription factors partition into five modules m1-m5 with distinct regulatory effects on lps-response programs p1-p5 including opposing regulation of alternative differentiation states.

components.name: proposition
values: mimosca a regularized linear model with elastic net can estimate perturbation effects on gene expression while accounting for technical and biological covariates and can incorporate interaction terms.

components.name: observation
values: 94% 92%-96% detection probability in k562 tf pool moi 0.63 98% in cell-cycle pool moi 0.35 60% in bmdcs at 3 hr moi 1.4 increasing to 70% after filtering low-complexity cells.

components.name: observation
values: fitness effects of sgrnas are assessed by fold change in abundance compared to initial pool with significance determined via a bayesian model using binomial p value and bonferroni correction.

components.name: observation
values: saturation analysis in bmdcs at 3 hr shows that with a median of 155 cells per perturbation and 5 074 transcripts per cell correlation with full data is high fewer cells per perturbation and lower transcript counts reduce recovery.

components.name: metric
values: tf module effects on cell states in bmdcs

components.name: observation
values: modules m2 and m4 have opposing effects on bmdc cell states m2 cebpb rela junb enriches for p2 state and depletes p5 state m4 spi1 irf4 nfkb1 runx1 has opposite effects.

components.name: observation
values: most tf pairs involving runx1 irf1 irf2 or irf4 had additive effects pairs with stat1 stat2 stat3 rela nfkb1 spi1 were enriched for interactions pairs with nfkb1 stat1-nfkb1 stat3-nfkb1 rela-nfkb1 spi1-nfkb1 were enriched for buffering interactions.

components.name: observation
values: in bmdcs 24 tfs partition into five modules m1-m5 regulating distinct transcriptional programs p1-p5 in response to lps including antiviral inflammatory mitochondrial biogenesis and two alternative differentiation programs.

components.name: observation
values: over 66% of cells are affected by their delivered perturbation on average based on the iterative model re-assignment.

components.name: observation
values: in k562 cells 10 tfs partition into two modules figure 6a affecting gene expression and cell states individual tf functions consistent with known biology e.g. egr1 yy1 gabpa .

components.name: observation
values: perturbations of cell-cycle regulators in k562 cells reveal distinct transcriptional profiles associated with similar fitness effects and mitotic arrest.

components.name: method
values: cell cycle regulator perturb-seq analysis | used perturb-seq with 10 cell-cycle regulators in k562 cells analyzed effects on cell-cycle states and gene expression revealing distinct profiles associated with similar fitness effects and mitotic arrest.

cell state definition | cell states defined from unperturbed cells by selecting variable genes via loess regression on coefficient of variation vs. mean expression normalizing to 10 000 transcripts log2 transformation z-transformation randomized pca retaining top 10 components clustering with infomap and iterative merging until no pairwise clusters have <100 differentially expressed genes welch s t test benjamini-hochberg fdr .

mimosca computational framework | a regularized linear model elastic net predicting each gene s expression as a function of guide effects technical covariates number of transcripts detection probability and biological covariates cell state subtype . permutation-based significance testing. iterative re-assignment of perturbation probability to cells. can incorporate interaction terms for genetic interactions or cell-state-specific effects.

perturb-seq | a method combining pooled crispr screen with single-cell rna-seq readout. lentiviral vector delivers sgrna and an expressed gbc. cells are transduced selected facs or antibiotics grown/differentiated/stimulated then scrna-seq performed in a single pool. gbcs are enriched via pcr after whole transcriptome amplification. moi can be varied for single or combinatorial perturbations.

components.name: result_metric
values: tf module effects on cell states in bmdcs

components.name: task
values: accounted for technical covariates cell quality detection probability and biological covariates cell subtypes/states .
designed a crispr lentiviral vector expressing sgrna and a guide barcode gbc .
developed mimosca a regularized linear model to estimate perturbation effects on gene expression.
developed perturb-seq combining pooled crispr screens with single-cell rna-seq readout.
included interaction terms for genetic and cell-state interactions.
performed six perturb-seq experiments analyzing 200 000 cells in bmdcs and k562 cells.
